run_benchmark_jax_warp: run MJX-Warp benchmark with JAX WARP FFI on humanoid model for kinematics function
run_benchmark_pure_jax: run pure JAX benchmark on a MuJoCo model with configurable environments and steps
run_benchmark_raw_warp: run raw Warp benchmark on a MuJoCo model without JAX for kinematics or forward
test_benchmark_functions: test the benchmark functions for kinematics, forward, step, and collision operations
run_benchmark_rendering: run MJX-Warp benchmark with RGB and depth rendering enabled on a MuJoCo model
